{"type":"thought","data":"The FaZe midpoint is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 0."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe FaZe ask is 0.73,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" well above the displayed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.675. I need to check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" `bench bet --help` "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to see if orders fill"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or cross the spread."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A better probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate is also needed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFaZe is ranked 17th"}
{"type":"thought","data":" globally and 19th in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" valve points. Their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roster includes Twistzz,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" frozen, Neityu, jcobbb,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and benched JBOEN. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"They recently won the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Roman Imperium Cup "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on October 10. Earlier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they lost to Astralis,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nemiga, magic, and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Alliance."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFaZe has a four-win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" streak ending October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10. They are playing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" DraculaN for Major "}
{"type":"thought","data":"invite chances. BASEMENT"}
{"type":"thought","data":" BOYS is ranked 100th"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in VRS points and is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Ukrainian tier three."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Their roster includes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" kAlash, Tr0ublE, OWNER,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" maggent, and kr1vda."}
{"type":"thought","data":" They just qualified"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from Group A."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBASEMENT BOYS lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Eternal Fire 1-2"}
{"type":"thought","data":" two weeks ago. They"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have historical LAN"}
{"type":"thought","data":" success at DraculaN"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but the current roster"}
{"type":"thought","data":" differs. Their aimclub"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match rating was 1.11,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which was competitive."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The VRS point gap is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 450 points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" In CS2 that gap makes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe a heavy favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA 400-point VRS gap"}
{"type":"thought","data":" typically yields a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"map win probability "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of 70% to 80%. That "}
{"type":"thought","data":"translates to roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 72% to 84% series win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability for FaZe."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The displayed market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price near 68% therefore"}
{"type":"thought","data":" looks slightly low "}
{"type":"thought","data":"unless the true map "}
{"type":"thought","data":"win rate is closer to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 63% to 65%. LAN variance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at DraculaN in Bucharest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could explain the lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price, since underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sometimes perform better"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on LAN."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFaZe's recent losses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Alliance, magic,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Nemiga suggest "}
{"type":"thought","data":"their roster is inconsistent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" They may not field "}
{"type":"thought","data":"their full lineup despite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Major motivation. BASEMENT"}
{"type":"thought","data":" BOYS looked solid in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" group stage. The wide"}
{"type":"thought","data":" spread and soft market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price point to inefficiency."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFaZe's recent wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" were against tier two"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and academy teams. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Their losses to Astralis"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Nemiga are more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" telling than their "}
{"type":"thought","data":"defeats to magic and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Alliance. BASEMENT "}
{"type":"thought","data":"BOYS are roughly tier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three, so FaZe should"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win this comfortably."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The only real upset"}
{"type":"thought","data":" risk is BASEMENT BOYS"}
{"type":"thought","data":" beating aimclub."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI calculated the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on FaZe at both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the midpoint and the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask. At the midpoint,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an 80% true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly +17 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"EV, while at the ask"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it drops to about +10."}
{"type":"thought","data":" At a fair 68% probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the midpoint would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"break even. BASEMENT"}
{"type":"thought","data":" BOYS at 0.325 is next."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBASEMENT BOYS at 0.315"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly +27 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"EV if their true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 40%, but about -37"}
{"type":"thought","data":" EV at 20%. The contest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is winner-take-all "}
{"type":"thought","data":"based on P&L, so the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is to maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected profit against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf every agent picks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe and FaZe wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the payouts will be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nearly identical. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only way to win outright"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is to pick BASEMENT"}
{"type":"thought","data":" BOYS as an upset if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents all"}
{"type":"thought","data":" take FaZe."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" means the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning, not the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe is the clear favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" here, so betting on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" them is the safer choice"}
{"type":"thought","data":" even if the payout "}
